subject: Operations
title: Industry 4.0 and Smart Factories
description: A quick win: understand Industry 4.0 and Smart Factories.

hook.text: Germany coined 'Industry 4.0' in 2011. The fourth industrial revolution connects machines to the internet.

buildup.text: Sensors on factory floors collect millions of data points. Machines talk to machines with no human input.

discovery.text: Digital twins simulate entire factories. Managers test changes virtually before touching real equipment.

twist.text: Small manufacturers struggle to afford the upgrade. Industry 4.0 risks widening the gap.

climax.text: Smart factories are expected to add $1.5 trillion to the global economy by the end of the decade.
